rules.statement: When a defendant says that the land described in the plaint is only a portion of a larger land or vice versa, the Court has authority to re-issue a commission to another surveyor.
rules.supporting_quote: Since the introduction of partition law in this country, when a defendant says that the land described in the plaint is only a portion of a larger land or vice versa, the Court has authority to re-issue a commission to another surveyor.
